name: acecraft-shop-items-atlas-v001
tool: built-in image_gen; one generation, no revision
status: New sprite atlas proposal prepared; root normal UI registration and actual screen review pending
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one transparent game-item sprite atlas, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, six independent new vintage cartoon objects. Overall canvas aspect 3:2, intended final size 600x400 pixels, each equal cell 200x200. Do not draw the grid. In every cell, center one entire independent object, with at least 12 pixels of completely transparent safe margin inside all four cell boundaries. No objects cross a cell boundary and no object is clipped.
TOP ROW LEFT: a compact free-reward bundle of a few stacked golden coins, folded green banknotes, and one small red ticket, composed as one small pile.
TOP ROW CENTER: a small bright red cylindrical energy bottle with a metallic silver cap and a simple cream lightning symbol, no label or lettering.
TOP ROW RIGHT: a teal-blue Overdrive-style recruitment ticket, slightly tilted, with a clean white faceted gem symbol in the center, no lettering.
BOTTOM ROW LEFT: a little closed golden treasure chest with rounded lid, brass latch and warm cream highlights, clearly shut.
BOTTOM ROW CENTER: a red pilot recruitment ticket, slightly tilted in the opposite direction, with a small cream wing emblem only, no lettering.
BOTTOM ROW RIGHT: one tiny cream-and-dusty-blue propeller wingman plane, toy-like short round fuselage, small wings and simple propeller, shown three-quarter side view.
Style: cohesive clean 1930s western vintage 2D cartoon ink, medium dark-brown outlines, cheerful flat warm colors, restrained small highlights. All six objects have comparable visual scale and are legible when reduced to about 100 pixels. Every part is newly illustrated. Genuine transparent alpha background and fully transparent inter-cell gaps. No scene, no ground, no frame, no card border around sprites, no panel, no buttons, no UI, no text, no words, no numbers, no quantity marks, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no drop shadows, no cast shadows, no glow. Do not bake any typography or price into any object.
referencePolicy: Original frames were viewed read-only; none of their pixels were copied into production. Objects are newly drawn approximations.
transform: Each generated512x512cell was trimmed around alpha>=10 content plus8 source pixels, proportionally resized within184x184, and centered into exact200x200 cells; full original retained. No semantic drawing edit or source screenshot crop.
limitations: Generic new vintage cartoon objects differ from original item art. The teal white-gem ticket is a deliberately new clean symbol rather than the source plane-shaped ticket.
No actual purchase/claim/item identity or balance policy is encoded. All prices/counts/labels must remain native text.
